verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since an AI video platform could plausibly offer in-frame element replacement or restyling, but the evidence shows nothing of the kind. The closest items are adjacent features that earn no credit here. Video Agent scene-level revision (only named scenes change) works on whole scenes over time, not on an element inside the frame. Translation lip-sync and re-recording avatar lines regenerate speech, not a creator-chosen element. No evidence shows selecting an object or region in an existing video and replacing or restyling it while the rest of the frame stays intact.
